401.en: My brother got into a fight at school yesterday.
401.zh: 我弟弟昨天在学校打架了。

402.en: The nurse took a small sample of my blood.

403.en: Can you tell me the reason you are late?
403.zh: 你能告诉我你迟到的理由吗？

405.en: Please help me pick some apples from the tree.
405.zh: 请帮我从树上摘一些苹果。

406.en: My neighbor has a very friendly brown dog.
406.zh: 我的邻居养了一只很友善的棕色狗。

407.en: It is too hot to go outside today.
407.zh: 今天太热了，不适合出门。

408.en: Walk straight ahead and you will see the store.
408.zh: 一直向前走，你就会看到那家店。

409.en: My sister is two years younger than me.

410.en: We walked along the river after dinner last night.
410.zh: 昨晚晚饭后我们沿着河边散步。

411.en: She wore a beautiful white dress to the party.
411.zh: 她穿了一条漂亮的白裙子去参加聚会。

412.en: The water feels cool on a hot summer day.
412.zh: 在炎热的夏天，水摸起来很凉爽。

413.en: I want to buy a new phone next month.
413.zh: 我下个月想买一部新手机。

414.en: Please stand in front of the door and wait.

415.en: You are free to leave whenever you want.

416.en: Please turn on the light so I can read.

417.en: I borrowed a very interesting book from the library.
417.zh: 我从图书馆借了一本很有趣的书。

418.en: She is telling a funny story to the children.
418.zh: 她正在给孩子们讲一个有趣的故事。

419.en: I will be back in about one hour.

420.en: Sometimes I like to read before going to bed.
420.zh: 我有时喜欢在睡觉前读书。

421.en: My daughter loves to draw pictures of animals.
421.zh: 我女儿喜欢画动物的画。

422.en: You can choose either the red one or the blue one.
422.zh: 你可以选红色的那个或蓝色的那个。

423.en: The country suffered greatly during the long war.
423.zh: 这个国家在漫长的战争中遭受了巨大痛苦。

424.en: The child was playing happily in the park.
424.zh: 那个孩子在公园里开心地玩耍。

425.en: Shanghai is the largest city in China by population.
425.zh: 上海是中国人口最多的城市。

426.en: Don't call him stupid; he just doesn't understand yet.
426.zh: 别叫他笨蛋，他只是还没明白而已。

427.en: She has long black hair and bright eyes.
427.zh: 她有长长的黑发和明亮的眼睛。

428.en: Please send me the file when you are done.
428.zh: 你完成后请把文件发给我。

429.en: Do you know the answer to this math question?
429.zh: 你知道这道数学题的答案吗？

430.en: The king ruled the kingdom for over fifty years.
430.zh: 那位国王统治王国超过五十年。

431.en: In fact, I have never been to that city.
431.zh: 事实上，我从未去过那个城市。

432.en: I have a strange feeling this is going to work.
432.zh: 我有种奇怪的感觉，这事能成。

433.en: My daddy taught me how to ride a bike.
433.zh: 我爸爸教会了我怎么骑自行车。

434.en: I am so glad you could come to visit us.
434.zh: 我很高兴你能来看我们。

435.en: You can trust him because he always keeps his word.
435.zh: 你可以信任他，因为他总是信守诺言。

436.en: You are always welcome to stay at our home.
436.zh: 随时欢迎你来我们家住。

437.en: The sky is very clear and blue this morning.
437.zh: 今天早上的天空非常晴朗蔚蓝。

438.en: China is a very large country with a long history.
438.zh: 中国是一个历史悠久的大国。

439.en: It is cold outside so wear a warm coat.
439.zh: 外面很冷，所以穿件暖和的外套。

440.en: We need to hurry or we will miss the bus.
440.zh: 我们得快点，否则会错过公交车。

441.en: Please wait here till I come back from the store.
441.zh: 请在这里等到我从商店回来。

442.en: We need to keep everything in good order.
442.zh: 我们需要把一切都保持得井井有条。

443.en: Once upon a time, there lived a brave young man.
443.zh: 从前，有一个勇敢的年轻人。

444.en: She felt sick and decided to stay home today.
444.zh: 她觉得不舒服，决定今天待在家。

445.en: The female dog gave birth to five cute puppies.
445.zh: 那只母狗生了五只可爱的小狗。

446.en: He is able to speak three different languages fluently.
446.zh: 他能流利地说三种不同的语言。

447.en: I bet you will enjoy this movie very much.
447.zh: 我打赌你会非常喜欢这部电影。

448.en: She was wearing a bright red scarf around her neck.
448.zh: 她脖子上围着一条鲜红的围巾。

449.en: She has long brown hair tied in a ponytail.
449.zh: 她有一头扎成马尾的棕色长发。

450.en: We should try to save more water every day.
450.zh: 我们应该每天尽量节约更多的水。

451.en: I heard some very exciting news on the radio today.
451.zh: 我今天在收音机上听到了一些很令人兴奋的消息。

452.en: What sort of music do you like to listen to?
452.zh: 你喜欢听哪种类型的音乐？

453.en: She makes a living by selling handmade jewelry online.
453.zh: 她靠网上卖手工首饰谋生。

454.en: The fresh air in the mountains makes me feel relaxed.
454.zh: 山里的新鲜空气让我感到放松。

455.en: There are exactly ten people in our study group.
455.zh: 我们学习小组正好有十个人。

456.en: If you keep working hard, you have nothing to lose.
456.zh: 如果你继续努力，你没有什么可失去的。

457.en: He loves to shoot photos of birds in the wild.
457.zh: 他喜欢在野外拍摄鸟类的照片。

458.en: She has been running every morning for three years.
458.zh: 她已经坚持每天早上跑步三年了。

459.en: We had a wonderful time at the beach last weekend.
459.zh: 上周末我们在海滩度过了美好的时光。

460.en: Nobody is perfect, so don't be too hard on yourself.
460.zh: 没有人是完美的，所以别对自己太苛刻。

461.en: To be frank, I don't really like this kind of food.
461.zh: 坦白说，我不太喜欢这种食物。

462.en: The storm knocked out the power in our neighborhood.
462.zh: 暴风雨导致我们小区停电了。

463.en: Can you drive me to the train station this afternoon?
463.zh: 你今天下午能开车送我去火车站吗？

464.en: There is a small coffee shop across the street.
464.zh: 街对面有一家小咖啡店。

465.en: Every citizen should obey the law of the land.
465.zh: 每个公民都应该遵守国家的法律。

466.en: I love trying new food when I travel abroad.
466.zh: 我在国外旅行时喜欢尝试新的食物。

467.en: Thankfully, everyone in the accident is still alive.
467.zh: 所幸，事故中每个人都还活着。

468.en: The sound of rain helps me fall asleep at night.
468.zh: 雨声帮助我在晚上入睡。

469.en: I promise to finish my homework before dinner tonight.
469.zh: 我保证今晚晚饭前完成作业。

470.en: Listening to music is my favorite way to relax.
470.zh: 听音乐是我最喜欢的放松方式。

471.en: The students learned about human sex education in class.
471.zh: 学生们在课堂上学习了人类性教育。

472.en: Good luck on your exam tomorrow, my dear friend.
472.zh: 祝你明天考试好运，我亲爱的朋友。

473.en: This is a very serious problem that needs attention.
473.zh: 这是一个需要关注的非常严重的问题。

474.en: She has worked at the same company for ten years.
474.zh: 她在同一家公司工作了十年。

475.en: This cake tastes very sweet but also very delicious.
475.zh: 这个蛋糕尝起来很甜，但也非常好吃。

476.en: They were too poor to buy new shoes for the children.
476.zh: 他们太穷了，没钱给孩子们买新鞋。

477.en: Please do not touch the paintings in the museum.
477.zh: 请不要触碰博物馆里的画。

478.en: Today is a very special day because it is my birthday.
478.zh: 今天是一个非常特别的日子，因为是我的生日。

479.en: Perhaps we should go by train instead of driving.
479.zh: 也许我们应该坐火车去，而不是开车。

480.en: Please hang your coat on the hook by the door.
480.zh: 请把你的外套挂在门边的钩子上。

481.en: They like to dance together at parties on weekends.
481.zh: 他们喜欢周末在聚会上一起跳舞。

482.en: I caught a bad cold and had to rest at home.
482.zh: 我得了重感冒，不得不在家休息。

483.en: Our team won the basketball game by just two points.
483.zh: 我们队仅以两分之差赢了篮球比赛。

484.en: Please pull the door open, do not push it.

485.en: We need to make a plan before we start the project.
485.zh: 在开始项目之前我们需要制定一个计划。

486.en: I drink a cup of coffee every morning after breakfast.
486.zh: 我每天早饭后喝一杯咖啡。

487.en: He climbed to the very top of the tall mountain.
487.zh: 他爬到了那座高山的最高处。

488.en: Please keep your wallet in a safe place at all times.
488.zh: 请始终把钱包放在安全的地方。

489.en: What is the date of your final exam this semester?
489.zh: 这学期期末考试是什么日期？

490.en: He runs very fast and often wins the race.
490.zh: 他跑得非常快，经常赢得比赛。

491.en: You seem tired today; did you get enough sleep?
491.zh: 你今天看起来很累，睡够了吗？

492.en: I felt very lucky to meet you on that day.
492.zh: 那天遇见你，我觉得非常幸运。

493.en: Let's go for a walk in the park this evening.
493.zh: 今晚我们去公园散步吧。

494.en: The president will give a speech on television tonight.
494.zh: 总统今晚将在电视上发表演讲。

495.en: They live in a small but very cozy apartment.
495.zh: 他们住在一间虽小但很舒适的公寓里。

496.en: Can you take a picture of us in front of the fountain?
496.zh: 你能帮我们在喷泉前拍张照片吗？

497.en: Please sign your name at the bottom of the page.
497.zh: 请在这页的底部签上你的名字。

498.en: She has a strong sense of what is right and wrong.
498.zh: 她对是非有很强的判断力。

499.en: Run fast or you won't catch the last train home.
499.zh: 跑快点，否则你赶不上最后一班回家的火车。

500.en: I can't figure out how to solve this difficult puzzle.
500.zh: 我想不出怎么解开这道难题。

501.en: The meeting was postponed until next Monday at ten o'clock.
501.zh: 会议被推迟到下周一十点。

502.en: I like to ride my bicycle along the river path.
502.zh: 我喜欢沿着河边小路骑自行车。

503.en: She trained very hard and managed to win the competition.
503.zh: 她训练非常刻苦，最终赢得了比赛。

504.en: Please write down your name and phone number on this form.
504.zh: 请在这张表上写下你的名字和电话号码。

505.en: Be careful not to drop the glass on the floor.
505.zh: 小心别把玻璃杯掉在地上。

506.en: I had a strange dream about flying last night.
506.zh: 昨晚我做了一个关于飞翔的奇怪的梦。
